'''Chambell's militia''' was a militia active on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Gimmel/Legends|Ord Gimmel]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]]. It supported [[Geit Chambell]]'s claim to the [[Geharran royal family|throne]] of Ord Gimmel.<ref name="Strongholds" />
